title: Missing Woman’s Roommate Realizes Cops Know About the Chainsaw
description:
A Florida woman was met by police after calling 911 and reporting her roommate as a missing person. Gisselle Victoria-Gonzalez claimed she hasn't seen her roommate, Runyleidy Medina-Pacheco, since Christmas Day. Gisselle moved out of that Orlando apartment shortly after, while detectives investigated Runy's disappearance. As the investigation continued, officers found numerous inconsistencies in Gisselle's story, leading to her arrest. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
